fixed_threads.description: Unresolved jury threads that the current code fixes.

thread_id.description: The id of the review thread in the PR context file.

reply.description: A short reply that states how the code fixes the issue.

thread_replies.description: Replies to unresolved review threads of other authors.

thread_id.description: The id of the review thread in the PR context file.

comments.description: New review comments, one for each issue.

path.description: The file path relative to the repository root.

line.description: The diff line for the comment, or the last line of a range. Null for a comment on the whole file.

start_line.description: The first line of a range. Null for a comment on one line or on the whole file.

side.description: RIGHT for a line in the new version of the file. LEFT for a deleted line.

lgtm.description: True only when comments is empty and no unresolved review thread needs more work.
